[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]

Replacer for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url] to include seasonal variants - based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url].
I've mostly stuck to the colors provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23126]Smol Nublet's Color Edit[/url].

This version is for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].
There will eventually be a vanilla version.


[b][size=4]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b]

I personally recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26601]AHCUTEART's Seasonal Portraits[/url].
Disable [u]Magnus[/u] and [u]Wizard[/u] sprites in the mod's settings, or they won't appear in-game.
